title: Test the worktree guard with and without companion config
action: Without reading the psu-1 worker's notes, check the psu-1 commit against CONTEXT.md D1 and contract d21eab69, then add behavior tests in verbs/worktree/tests.rs next to the existing nested-checkout and companion tests: a temp repo with a nested .git dir (not a registered submodule) and a second live session record (fresh last_heartbeat). Both bee worktree new and bee feature start call the one helper check_shared_nested_checkout_guard in verbs/worktree/companion.rs, so cover worktree new end to end and the helper directly: no companion config creates the worktree and prints the warning; both companion commands set refuses naming --with-companion and creates nothing; only one set counts as NotConfigured; a solo session never refuses. Fix any defect you find in psu-1's code (companion.rs only) and name it in the cap. No code comments.
